Instrument (EN): Contrast Avoidance Questionnaire — General Emotion, validated eight-item IRT short form

Instrument (EN): State Shame and Guilt Scale — Arabic revised 10-item psychometric adaptation
Scales / measured domains (EN): Two factors: state shame (5 items) and state guilt (5 items); separate dimension scores
Research provenance: Chbeir A et al., Frontiers in Psychology 17:1807388, 2026-05-13, DOI 10.3389/fpsyg.2026.1807388; translated into Arabic with forward/back translation; 611 adult respondents from Lebanon, Jordan, Egypt, Iraq, pooled CFA 2 factors (CFI .993, TLI .991, RMSEA .082), McDonald omega shame .86 guilt .87; gender/country invariance.
DB locales: No corresponding published Supabase edition; parent SSGS-15 and other language 15-item variants already indexed in research master. This is a distinct Arabic TEN-item adapted version, not a duplicate of 15.
EN form: Original English parent instrument exists; 2026 study NOT independent validation of English respondent edition.
RU form: No RU respondent translation validated in cited study.
ES form: No ES respondent translation validated in cited study.
Other translations: Arabic version translated and empirically evaluated across four countries; ONE Arabic edition, NOT four independent language validations or country-specific norms.
Target population: 611 Arabic-speaking adults in Lebanon, Jordan, Egypt and Iraq; pooled online cross-sectional survey; not tested in youth or clinical diagnostic population.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Article CC BY allows article reuse under its terms but does not establish ownership/rights for underlying source SSGS, item adaptation or ongoing commercially hosted administration. Request rights confirmation, exact version provenance, approved scoring and interpretation.
Verification notes / safety gate: RESEARCH_ONLY / PERMISSION_REQUIRED. Arabic administered questionnaire is independently studied; no RU/ES validation. Shame/guilt are sensitive, not clinical diagnoses; 10-item edition must not inherit 15-item scoring. Test-language not synonymous with UI translation.
